From 7a4697b201a617907e4b440ae34df601d4755bef Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2021 03:10:04 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] spi: stm32: fix excluded_middle.cocci warnings

drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c:915:23-25: WARNING !A || A && B is equivalent to !A || B

 Condition !A || A && B is equivalent to !A || B.

Generated by: scripts/coccinelle/misc/excluded_middle.cocci

Fixes: 7ceb0b8a3ced ("spi: stm32: finalize message either on dma callback or EOT")
CC: Alain Volmat <alain.volmat@foss.st.com>
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Alain Volmat <alain.volmat@foss.st.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210713191004.GA14729@5eb5c2cbef84
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c b/drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c
index 14ca7ea04e47..9bd3fd1652f7 100644
--- a/drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c
+++ b/drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c
@@ -912,8 +912,7 @@ static irqreturn_t stm32h7_spi_irq_thread(int irq, void *dev_id)
 		if (!spi->cur_usedma && (spi->rx_buf && (spi->rx_len > 0)))
 			stm32h7_spi_read_rxfifo(spi);
 		if (!spi->cur_usedma ||
-		    (spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX ||
-		     spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX)))
+		    (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX))
 			end = true;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c`**
- The conditional statement in the `stm32h7_spi_irq_thread` function was modified. 
- The original condition:
  ```c
  if (!spi->cur_usedma || (spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX)))
  ```
  was simplified to:
  ```c
  if (!spi->cur_usedma || (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX))
  ```
- This change addresses a warning generated by the `excluded_middle.cocci` script, indicating that the original condition was unnecessarily complex and could be simplified.

### Relationships
- The modification in `drivers/spi/spi-stm32.c` is directly related to the warning reported by the kernel test robot, which identified the conditional expression as equivalent to a simpler form. 
- The patch is intended to improve code clarity and maintainability by removing redundant logic, thus fixing the warning without altering the functionality of the code. 
- The change is also linked to a previous commit (identified by the hash `7ceb0b8a3ced`) that finalized message handling in the SPI driver, indicating that this simplification is part of ongoing improvements to the driver code.

```c
if (!spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX)))
```
Reason:
The conditional expression `!spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_usedma && (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX))` is unnecessarily complex and can lead to confusion. It is equivalent to `!spi->cur_usedma || (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX)`, which simplifies the logic but may mislead maintainers about the intended flow.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (!spi->cur_usedma ||
    (spi->cur_comm == SPI_SIMPLEX_TX || spi->cur_comm == SPI_3WIRE_TX))
```
Reason:
The revised condition simplifies the logic by removing the redundant check for `spi->cur_usedma` in the second part of the expression. This makes the code clearer and easier to maintain, while preserving the original behavior of the logic.
